front: When was the Southern Rhodesia African National Congress formed and banned?
List the nationalist parties 1955-1963 in order.
back: City Youth League (1955), SRANC (1957), NDP (1960), ZAPU (1961), ZANU (1963).

front: Who were ZANU's first president and secretary-general (1963)?

back: Unlawful Organisations Act (1959), Preventive Detention Act (1959), Law and Order (Maintenance) Act (1960).
Government chosen by all adults voting equally: one person, one vote.

front: What did the 1961 constitution offer Africans?
back: 15 of the 65 seats in parliament; the NDP rejected it.
The People's Caretaker Council, formed by Nkomo's ZAPU supporters in 1963 after the split.

front: Give four challenges nationalists faced in 1957-1964.
back: Bans, detention of leaders, repressive laws, divisions after 1963 (also the Rhodesian Front's rise and little outside help).

front: What happened to ZANU and the PCC in August 1964?
back: Both were banned and their leaders detained or restricted (e.g. Gonakudzingwa, Sikombela).
